outcome.technical: tests/test_drive_phase.py only. (a) ab7/ab8/ab9: copy_d is now built from wt.native_spelling(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir) before the audit-advance join, so ab9's `os.path.join(copy_d, "git-index") in text_d` compares the platform spelling on both sides, matching the stop's _worktrees.kept_where spelling. The case's other path uses were checked: isdir/exists accept either spelling, `named` comes from restore_command over the suite's own native mpath_d/root_d, and the other `audit-advance` checks are substrings. Other git-printed paths in the suite (copy_k in ab6, the two --git-common-dir reads in _force_added/_exclude) are used only for filesystem calls, never compared against text, so they were left as they are. (b) sd14's root moved into a module constant SD_LONG_ROOT, two spaced components with no trailing space. The old components ended in a space, and win32 trims a trailing space only from a path's last component, so makedirs created the parent without it and then could not find the child (WinError 3); the old root was also far past MAX_PATH. A comment beside the constant states the budget: _WIN_RUNNER_TEMP (the runner's temp prefix as the windows cells print it) + fixture dir name + root + deepest path the drive writes, all within _WIN_MAX_PATH less its NUL. New case sd16 (via _win_path_budget) adds up that sum from the tree sd14 leaves, on every platform: here 214 against 259, the deepest path being docs/audit/evidence/returns/P1.1/<stamp>.executor.json. sd16 also asserts that no root component ends in a space or a dot, and that the root is spaced. sd14 still passes on posix (first_path 500). For sd14 on windows, ctx gitRoot is os.path.abspath (drive-phase.py near line 10927), so it is native and held.find(deep) compares like with like. Commands: `python3 tests/test_drive_phase.py --selftest --stage sd-block` -> 22/22, exit 0; `--stage ab-block` -> 12/12, exit 0 (scratch export); `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_drive_phase.py` -> exit 0, '1/1 files ok, 814 cases'; `ruff check tests/test_drive_phase.py` exit 0; `vermin -t=3.8- --no-tips --violations tests/test_drive_phase.py` exit 0; prose_number_claims()/house_style_violations() report nothing for the file. Dependants: .github/sweep-costs.json still correct (no block added or renamed; sd-block gains one os.walk); .github/workflows/ci.yml unchanged and still correct (it runs the suite as before); drive-phase.py untouched, and paths_last's docstring naming sd14 is still true; tests/test__runner_output.py, tests/test_run_test_gate.py, tests/test_stamp_verification.py, tools/affected.py, tools/reach-diff.py still correct, because the names they use (_actions, _bindings, _counting, _follower_cases and the rest) are untouched and the only additions are new names (SD_LONG_ROOT, _WIN_RUNNER_TEMP, _WIN_MAX_PATH, _win_path_budget). Owner's Windows check, from the checkout: `py -3 tests\test_drive_phase.py --selftest --stage ab-block` expecting 'ALL PASS: 12/12 cases passed', and `py -3 tests\test_drive_phase.py --selftest --stage sd-block` expecting 'ALL PASS: 22/22 cases passed' (or `py -3 tools\sweep-selftests.py tests\test_drive_phase.py` expecting '1/1 files ok'). A local TEMP longer than the runner's (a longer user name) eats into the 45-character margin sd16 printed.
